title: Prediction of heart transplant rejection from routine pathology slides with self-supervised deep learning
study_context: Weakly supervised cardiac rejection prediction from routine histopathology across German transplant centers.
population_or_data: 1,079 slides from 325 patients at three transplant centers, organized into four cohorts.
task: Binary rejection detection and 0R/1R/2R-3R grade prediction.
method: Self-supervised features, attention-based MIL, cross-validation in a primary cohort, and deployment to three validation cohorts.
main_findings: Binary AUROC was 0.849 in cross-validation and 0.734, 0.729, and 0.716 in the three validation cohorts.
Performance varied by ISHLT grade and by cohort.
limitations: Retrospective cohorts were relatively small and the grade 1R task was difficult.
does_not_establish: It does not show that internal cross-validation performance will carry over unchanged to a new hospital.
relevance_to_project: Direct evidence that patient/cohort transportability must be measured rather than inferred from internal results.
